tools.name: gunsmith-loadout-20261012.json
tools.description: Import a planned Gunsmith loadout, explicitly map catalog entries to local prefabs and avatar parents, and preview additions or managed removals. Applies with Undo and persistent ownership checks; creator setup and real scene behavior still need validation.
requirements: An already-saved scene, exact avatar root, acquired creator prefabs and explicit parent mappings.
limitations: Source preview; pure-data tests and compilation passed, scene Undo/save-reopen and creator integration remain unverified.
Only instances created and tracked by this tool can be removed. Changed ownership, overrides or added objects block removal.
Local EditorPrefs ownership does not transfer when the project moves or the registry is cleared.
Attaches prefabs only; does not install dependencies, wire controllers or menus, save scenes, upload or optimize assets.
